seg_boundary_f — SEGMENTATION score op

• Data kinds: labels2d × labels2d → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.seg_boundary_f(labels_pred, labels_true, *, tau: 'float' = 2.0) -> 'Dict[str, object]' (to call the implementation directly, import segeval; segeval.seg_boundary_f(labels_pred, labels_true, *, tau: 'float' = 2.0) -> 'Dict[str, object]'; from the registry, opssegmentation.get("seg_boundary_f"))

Usage

Boundary F-measure at tolerance tau: precision = fraction of predicted boundary pixels within tau of a true boundary, recall the reverse (seg_boundary_f).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

F = 2PR/(P+R)。境界は _boundary の規約(ラベルの割れ目、1 画素幅)なので、ラベルの番号や背景の区別によらない(分割の形だけを見る)。距離は距離変換(ユークリッド、画素の中心)。τ = 0 で画素の一致。両方の境界が空(どちらも 1 色)なら P = R = F = 1、片方だけ空なら 0。

返り値: f、precision、recall、tau、n_pred_boundary / n_true_boundary、dist_pred_to_true / dist_true_to_pred(境界画素ごとの距離)。
